scheme.title: Access
scheme.description: Access condition of a resource or of one of its access points. Always explicit: it is never assumed to be public.

concepts.label: Public
concepts.description: Anyone can obtain the data without asking.

concepts.label: Restricted
concepts.description: The record is public, but the data needs a request, an account or an agreement.

concepts.label: Internal
concepts.description: Catalogued for the network; the data is not available outside the team that holds it.
